{"plan":"Convert the frozen original CUAWright script to CLI tool mode under the same contract: argparse --url/--todo with allowlist and step-0 parameter log, first matching checkbox once plus full #list li count, capture exact row text in FINAL_RESPONSE, main guard, 20s page timeout, Firefox headless 1280x1800, screenshots/log/cleanup unchanged, no sandbox disable and no extra network/storage/subprocess. External orchestration owns the run folder.","code":"import argparse
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

# param  type  default                              notes
# url    str   http://127.0.0.1:57186/healthy       allowlist /healthy|/duplicate|/no-check|/no-theme
# todo   str   milk                                 has_text filter; capture exact row text
ALLOWED = (
    "http://127.0.0.1:57186/healthy",
    "http://127.0.0.1:57186/duplicate",
    "http://127.0.0.1:57186/no-check",
    "http://127.0.0.1:57186/no-theme",
)
ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
SHOTS = ROOT / "screenshots"
LOG = ROOT / "final_script_log.txt"


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    print(msg, flush=True)
    with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(msg + "\n")


async def run(url: str, todo: str) -> None:
    SHOTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    LOG.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    log(f"step 0 parameters: url={url} todo={todo}")
    pw = await async_playwright().start()
    browser = None
    try:
        browser = await pw.firefox.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 1800})
        page.set_default_timeout(20000)
        await page.goto(url)
        log("step 1 action: click Dark theme control")
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Dark theme").click()
        await page.screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / "final_execution_1_dark_theme.png"))
        log("step 2 action: fill New todo and click Add once")
        await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="New todo").fill(todo)
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add").click()
        await page.screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / "final_execution_2_add_todo.png"))
        log("step 3 action: click first matching checkbox once")
        row = page.locator("#list li").filter(has_text=todo).first
        cb = row.get_by_role("checkbox")
        await cb.click()
        await page.screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / "final_execution_3_todo_checked.png"))
        theme = await page.evaluate(
            "document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme')"
            " || document.body.getAttribute('data-theme')"
            " || (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') || document.body.classList.contains('dark') ? 'dark' : (document.documentElement.className || document.body.className || ''))"
        )
        submits = await page.evaluate("window.submits")
        rows = await page.locator("#list li").count()
        checked = await cb.is_checked()
        exact = (await row.inner_text()).strip()
        log(
            f"FINAL_RESPONSE theme={theme} submits={submits} "
            f"list_li={rows} checkbox.checked={checked} exact_text={exact}"
        )
        await page.screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / "final_execution_4_final_state.png"))
    finally:
        if browser is not None:
            await browser.close()
        await pw.stop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--url", default="http://127.0.0.1:57186/healthy")
    p.add_argument("--todo", default="milk")
    a = p.parse_args()
    if a.url not in ALLOWED:
        raise SystemExit("rejected url")
    asyncio.run(run(a.url, a.todo))
"}

I am converting the CUAWright script into a CLI tool.

A conflict exists between the user's explicit ban on tools and agents and the cuawright-web skill requirement. I must resolve this before proceeding.

I will return only JSON containing the plan and code. I cannot execute the script directly because tools are forbidden.

I will reconstruct the CLI tool from memory without reading skill files. The script will accept --url and --todo arguments, reject URLs outside the allowed list, log step zero parameters, and click only the first matching checkbox in duplicate rows.

I will guard imports with a main block. The script must stay under 100 lines, use no state mutation or subprocesses, and default to a 20-second timeout. Screenshots go to screenshots/ and the log to final_script_log.txt. I will capture exact text in FINAL_RESPONSE.

The script will use Firefox headless at 1280x1800. It will not create run folders itself; external orchestration handles that. Screenshots and logs will be written to the parent directory of the script.

The URL must exactly match http://127.0.0.1:57186 followed by /healthy, /duplicate, /no-check, or /no-theme. Duplicate rows will have only the first matching checkbox clicked once, and the total row count reported without retrying. The has_text filter will use the todo text, while FINAL_RESPONSE captures the exact row text.

The /no-theme URL may lack the dark theme button. The /no-check URL may lack the checkbox. The /duplicate URL contains multiple milk rows.

I am drafting the script structure. I defined an ALLOWED set for the four valid URLs and mapped ROOT, SHOTS, and LOG paths to the parent directory. I also wrote a log helper that prints to stdout and appends to the final log file.

I am writing the `run` function. It creates the screenshots directory and clears the log, logs step zero parameters, launches Firefox headless at 1280x1800 with a 20-second timeout, navigates to the URL, and clicks the Dark theme button.

The script now fills the New todo field with the provided task and clicks Add. It then captures a screenshot of the list and locates the first matching row by text to click its checkbox.

The script now evaluates the active theme from data attributes or CSS classes, reads the submit count from window.submits, and counts list items.

The script now logs the final response with theme, submit count, list item count, checkbox state, and exact row text. It captures a final screenshot before closing the browser. I have started adding the argument parser.

The argument parser now defaults --todo to "milk" and rejects any URL outside the allowed set. The main guard calls asyncio.run with the parsed arguments. I am checking that the script stays under 100 lines. I am also weighing whether to skip the Dark theme click for the /no-theme variant.

I will not pass any sandbox-disabling arguments to the browser launcher. The code string must be carefully escaped for JSON output.

I will keep the original three-step flow intact for every allowed URL, including /no-theme and /no-check, even when those pages lack the dark theme button or the checkbox. The script will not create its own run folder; external orchestration handles that. I am finalizing a tight plan string to accompany the code.

I will use `page.set_default_timeout(20000)` for the page-wide timeout rather than passing it on every action. The argument parser will reject invalid URLs before the browser launches. I am adding a parameter table comment block to the script with type, default, and notes for both arguments.
